name: weak-namespace-token-access-v1

attributes.m$K8sThreatMatrix: Credential Access::Obtain service account tokens in unprivileged namespaces

description: determines which subjects can obtain service account tokens in unprivileged namespaces, either by reading or writing secrets or by creating a TokenRequest against serviceaccounts/token, letting them act as a service account that may hold broader permissions over the cluster than the namespace itself implies
remediation: Grant access to secrets and to the serviceaccounts/token subresource only to subjects that genuinely need it, and scope such rules with resourceNames where possible. Keep the service accounts of an ordinary namespace least privileged, so that a token obtained there is worth no more than the namespace itself.
